name: Xtream Bridge
description: Live TV control centre, persistent catalogue, channel rules, XMLTV mapping, multiple providers and optional native DVR. Preview: validate playback and recording on a test server.

versions.changelog: Live TV preview: organised settings, persistent safe sync, channel/group overrides, EPG mapping, diagnostics, multiple providers, optional native DVR and admin catch-up. Real-server verification pending.
Filter non-live stream types and on-demand URLs from Live TV and EPG; optionally hide VOD/series categories; hide provider indexes and clean known stream ID prefixes.
Initial release: Live TV, VOD movies, category controls and XMLTV guide.
